name: Rahul Varma
player_statement:
A complete player, Rahul Varma has made a big mark in cricket. With 165 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 106*, with an average of 25.52 and a quick strike rate of 122.03. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 95 sixes and 325 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 444.0 overs, taking 143 wickets at an economy rate of 6.95. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
